description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeDao for accessing customer attribute data from a database using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerAttribute, providing database access methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute entity by its ID, performing multiple joins to fetch associated entities.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerAttribute based on the option ID, customer ID, and store, with associated entity fetching.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer and store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Gets CustomerAttributes filtered by option value ID and store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttributes based solely on an option ID and store.
